tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi sngags kyi phrin las bzhugs so: :

bcom ldan 'das zhi khro rab 'byams lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: gsang ba sgrub chen las kyi khrigs: yi dam rgyun khyer sngags sgrub 'di: rgyud kyi bcud phyungs shin tu zab: 'di la sngon 'gro'i chos bdun no: dang po mtshams gcod byed pa ni: oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐: gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐: gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya hūm̐: ā na ya ho: bha ga wān: badz+ra bid+yā rā dzā ya hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐ badz+ra tsakra tīg+na karma kī la ya dz+wa la raṃ: oṃ badz+ra kro ta saṃ bha wa sa ma ya ru lu ru lu hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐ badz+ra bhi shwa tsakra dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la ha la ha la hūm̐ phaṭa: ༈ brda sgo dbye ba/ bh+rūm̐ pra be sha ya phaṭa: brda phyag 'tshal ba/ hūm̐ a ti pū ho: pra ti dza ho: dam bca' ba/ hūm̐ badz+ra tsit+ta sa ma ya hūm̐: byin dbab pa/ oṃ shrī badz+ra kro ta dhe wa sarba duṣ+ṭān: ḍā ki nī sa ma ya ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: ā be sha ya a ā: mchod pa byin rlabs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra ar+ghaṃ hūm̐: badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐: badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐: badz+ra ā lo ke hūm̐: badz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐: badz+ra nai bid+ya hūm̐: badz+ra shab+da hūm̐: badz+ra sarba pū dza me gha hūm̐: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: bdud rtsi byin rlabs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā sarba pañca a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: gtor ma byin rlabs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta ba la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya swā hā: rak+ta byin rlabs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pū tsa: ma hā pañca ma hā ba liṃ ta: ma hā rak+ta: a ho su kha sa ma ye swā hā: ༈ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: badz+ra sa ma ye dza: na ra ka: pre ta ka: tir ya ka: ma nu sha: dhe wa hrī: dhe wa a: ling bi shud+dhe: dak+sha ka shud+dhe shud+dhe swā hā: dngos gzhi chos gter nyer lnga las: oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: āḥdharma dhā tu swa bhā wa bi shud+dhe maṇ+ḍal hūm̐:

tsit+ta badz+ra hūm̐: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: 'byung ba rim brtsegs e yaṃ ra suṃ keṃ raṃ bh+rūm̐: bh+rūm̐ bhi shwa bhi shud+dhe: bhan+dha dz+nyā na e tsakra maṇ+ḍal hūm̐ bh+rūm̐: ru tra kro ti ti ra baṃ: ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la: a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la: paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: ma hā kro tī shwa rī s+t+waṃ: hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ha na ma tha bhañja hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta ma hā kro ta ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba big nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ gu ya dz+nyā na shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭān hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭān hūm̐ phaṭa: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: ma hā mu dra sa ma ya ho: oṃ āḥhūm̐: byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes lnga'i dbang bskur oṃ hūm̐ swā hrīḥhā: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta: badz+ra dz+nyā na pañca swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: oṃ e h+ye hi sa ma ya dza: spyan drangs*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: hring hring dza: sa ma ya ā be sha ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ba a ti pū ho: pra ti dza ho: na maḥshrī: ma hā mu dra pū tsa ho: ma hā dz+nyā na te te hūm̐: te na hūm̐: te te hūm̐ hūm̐: phyi mchod/ oṃ pa na peṃ pe nu su ra to: ti pu pa ra mu: sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sa ma ya ho: oṃ shrī rā ga badz+ra dhū pe dhū: puṣ+pe pu: ā lo ke hrī: gan+dhe gan: nai bid+ya ā: gīrti hrī: shab+da hūm̐: nang mchod/ hūm̐ sarba pū dza sa ma ya ho: gsang mchod/ ha la pañca pū tsa ho: ma hā rak+ta: dug gsum mchod pa/ ma hā kiṃ ni ri ti: ma hā māṃ sa khā hi: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sarba pañca a mṛta hūm̐ hrī:ṭhā: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi:

dngos grub blang ba/ kā ya sid+dhi oṃ: wā ka sid+dhi ā: tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: sarba sid+dhi hrī: ma hā ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi: ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi: ma hā pañca a mṛta khā hi: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: pad+ma yo gi ni: sa ma ya: a be sha ya ā: bsgral mchod oṃ ma hā shrī he ru ka: ma traṃ ru dra pra bhan tsakra hūm̐ phaṭa: pra be sha ya phaṭa: ti hūm̐ e s+pha ra na hūm̐ phaṭa: bstod mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: na mo hri da ya: oṃ na mo: sa ma ya e ho shud+dhe ā: bshags pa bya ba/ oṃ badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya: ma nu pā la ya: badz+ra he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha: dṛ ḍho me bha wa: su toṣ+yo me bha wa: a nu rak+to me bha wa: su poṣ+yo me bha wa: sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha: sarba karma su tsa me: tsit+taṃ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐: ha ha ha ha ho: bha ga wān: sarba ta thā ga ta: badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñca: badz+rī bha wa: ma hā sa ma ya: badz+ra he ru ka satwa ā: hūm̐: gsang ba yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor du: che mchog dpal dgu'i dbu rgyan nang: thabs shes nyi zla pad+ma'i steng: mi bskyod rnam par snang mdzad dang: rin 'byung mtha' yas don yod grub: yum chen kun bzang sangs rgyas spyan: mā ma gos dkar dam tshig sgrol: rgyal ba yab yum phyag mtshan bcas: kun bzang yab yum dgyes par rol: sras mchog sems dpa' sems ma bcas: sprul sku thub drug mthar byed brgyad: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gzhon tshul can: gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid dang: dbu rgyan cod pan phreng ba dang: do shal dpung rgyan se mo do: rin chen dar dpyang chas rnams rdzogs: sku ni zhi tshul dgu dang ldan: gsung ni yang snying sngags sgra sgrog: thugs ni rang byung ye shes gsal: 'dzab kyis sku gsung thugs rgyud bskul: 'phros pas stong gsum sku yis gang: sku las gsung byon sngags 'brug ldir: bsdus pas chos dbyings mkha' la thim: ma gsal bar du bskyed cing bsgom:

ma 'grub bar du mi gtang ngo: zhi ba rigs 'dus bsnyen pa/ oṃḥ.ā li kā li dz+nyā na pañca satwa kro ta mu na ye swā hā: oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhā tu ā: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: snying po brgya stong bzlas rjes su: stong tshigs mchod pa bya'o: hūm̐: dbus phyogs 'khor lo'i gzhal yas su: zla gam gru gsum e yi dkyil: byol song gtso brgyad dregs pa'i steng: thabs shes nyi zla 'od kyi dkyil: ma chags pad+ma ge sar la: bcom ldan che mchog he ru ka: yum ni gnam zhal dbyings phyug ma: gnyis med 'khril sbyor cha lugs ni: sgeg pa dpa' ba 'jigs su rung: rgod dang gshe dang snying rje rngam: 'bar zhi khro sogs gar dgur ldan: sku ni dur khrod chas rnams rdzogs: gsung ni drag po'i sngags sgra sgrog: thugs ni sgrol mdzad srog dang bcas: 'dzab kyis rgyud bskul sku gsung thugs: phaṭa kyis spros pas stong gsum gang: bsdus pas yum gyi mkha' la 'khyil: gsang ba'i sbubs nas thugs kar thim: ma gsal bar du bskyed cing bsgom: ma 'grub bar du mi gtang ngo: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: bzlas rjes stong tshigs mchod pa bya: hūm̐: ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bstod: nyams chag 'gal 'khrul mthol lo bshags: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā pañca ba liṃ ta rak+ta khā hi: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭiḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta badz+ra kro ta h+ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba big nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ gu ya dz+nyā na shrī he ru ka kro tī shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭān hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭān e dza bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa: ces gra zur ma nyams par bzlas so: yang sprul khyung chen bka' sdod rnams:

bzlas brjod bsnyen pa'i mchod pa 'bul: 'dzab rdzogs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: khroṃ badz+ra ga ru ḍā hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba ḍā ki nī sa ma ya hring hring hūm̐ phaṭa: zhes stong tshigs mchod pa bya ba ni: rtags sam grangs bsnyen bdun 'bum nyi khri la sbyar zhing bzlas so: hūm̐: lha dang rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro dgongs: 'dir bzhugs rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams: smin grol gnyis kyis rgyud sbyangs shing: bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyis las gzhung bsrang: bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhi mtha' ru phyin: las dang thugs rje mthun pa yi: zhi rgyas dbang drag yid bzhin gter: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐ ā: rjes kyi las rim bcu gcig las: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐: sarba duṣ+ṭān: shān+tiṃ: puṣ+ṭiṃ: wa shaṃ: mā ra ya rbad: hūm̐ sarba sid+dhi ku ru rbod zor sarba bh+yo bzlog: tshogs bya'o/ oṃ u tsuṣ+ma bai tā li kro ta nī sarba dra byaṃ sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā: a ho ma hā su kha sa ma ya ho: oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro ta bi dza ya kha raṃ khā hi: sid+dhi pha la a la la ho: lhag ma bya'o// oṃ ma hā shrī he ru ka sa ma ya dhe wi kro ta sarba ba liṃ ta khā hi khā hi: oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa badz+ra a tiṣ+ṭha sha mun sha tra ya sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hrī hrī hrī: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: e ā ral+li dza: badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭān trig nan e hur thuṃ dza: dgra bgegs nṛ tri sha truṃ mā ra ya rbad: brtan ma mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra a mṛta khā hi: ma ma hrīṃḥm ma hrīṃ: khā hi khā hi: oṃ oṃ oṃ: mi mthun phyogs rnams shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: swā swā swā: tshe dang bsod nams puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā:

hrīḥhrīḥhrī: lha 'dre mi gsum pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: hā hā hā: dgra bgegs gnod byed mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ dgra bgegs gnod byed dam sri s+t+wam+bha ya nan: oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐: ces pa dang: tshe 'gugs pa/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nṛ dza: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra mu: a ā: i ī: u ū: ṛ ṝ: li lī: e ai: o au: aṃ a: ka kha ga gha nga: tsa tsha dza dzha nya: ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa: ta tha da dha na: pa pha ba bha ma: ya ra la wa: sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa: ces dang: yi ge brgya pa brjod do: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: sprul sku rgod ldem can gyis byang zang zang lha brag gi sked nas spyan drangs pa'o: 'di bris rnam dkar pad+mo'i gnyen// ma lus 'gro ba'i dbyings khyab pas// chos khams kun+da 'dzum mkhas des// 'gro kun 'byor pas tshim par shog// /
